scalars.scalar_value: Proven clinical training and/or work experience in the acute care, inpatient setting.

items.item_text: California LCSW license (must have this certification to be hired at level III).
Minimum two (2) years of post-MSW Social Work experience is required to be hired at level II.

The pay scale for the CSW1 (less than 2 years post-MSW experience) is $78,561-103,458. The pay scale for the CSW2 (2+ years post-MSW experience) is $97,344-$128,200. The pay scale for the CSW3 (with California LCSW) is $109,220-$143,894.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
A Master's degree from an accredited school of social work (MSW).
Proven clinical training and/or work experience in the acute care, inpatient setting.
Experience working with child welfare population, Labor and Delivery, and NICU patients.
Experience working in a hospital and/or Emergency Department.

Under general supervision, and in addition to performing the full range of operational-level duties, the Clinical Social Worker is responsible for administering social service programs or relevant work. Provides social work services consisting of discharge planning, continuing care services, and clinical social work services, including crisis intervention, mandated reporting, information and referral, and coordination of health and mental health services with community providers. The social worker is responsible for education and advocacy of patients, families, and/or significant others. Participates in related department functions, such as community and program education. The Clinical Social Worker is required to work in all acute medical units, including NICU and burn. Complete assessments in the NICU within two days of admission, complete weekly and discharge progress notes, and have the ability to case find. Other duties as assigned.
Depending on experience of the selected candidate, this position will be hired at the Clinical Social Worker I, II or III level.
Must be able to work within a team environment.
Must possess the knowledge and abilities essential to the successful performance of the duties assigned to the position.
